WITH `category_revenue_cte` AS (

), `grand_total_revenue_cte` AS (

    )) AS `grand_total_revenue`

  JOIN `products` AS `p`
    ON `od`.`productid` = `p`.`productid`
)
SELECT
  `crc`.`categoryname` AS `category_name`,
  (
    `crc`.`category_revenue` / `gtrc`.`grand_total_revenue`

FROM `category_revenue_cte` AS `crc`
CROSS JOIN `grand_total_revenue_cte` AS `gtrc`
